questions.q: What caused the 1978 Portland plane crash, according to the summary?
a: The captain ignored his crew's warnings until the plane ran out of fuel
A mechanical failure destroyed the landing gear
The crew disagreed about which runway to use
Air traffic control gave the wrong instructions
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the captain delayed preparations while his crew warned him about fuel.

questions.q: What did United Airlines introduce after that crash?
a: Crew Resource Management, with teams handling emergencies together
A rule requiring two captains on every flight
Stricter limits on pilots' working hours
New simulators built for solo pilot training
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the program replaced one-person command with teamwork, later proven on the Hudson landing.

questions.q: At what size does the summary suggest splitting a company into multiple teams?
a: More than 150 people
More than 50 people
More than 500 people
More than 1,000 people
questions.why: Lesson 2 says teams become ineffective when too large, so bigger firms should form many teams.

questions.q: Why must the teams in a team of teams share information openly?
a: Otherwise teams choose what suits themselves but not the whole
Otherwise teams compete for the same resources
Otherwise leaders lose track of individual performance
Otherwise customers hear conflicting messages
questions.why: Lesson 2 says without shared context, a team's good local choice can harm the organization.

Requiring every decision to be signed off by a manager
Giving teams the right to set their own budgets
Rotating leaders between teams every quarter
questions.why: Lesson 3 says McChrystal cut the approval protocol so informed teams could move fast.
